name: arc-live-sidebar
description: Import the owner's actual Arc sidebar and history into an isolated native browser profile
given: Arc installed with live sidebar, profiles and history; packaged browser with bundled host
when: Detect Arc and invoke import from the real settings/onboarding bridge twice
then: All source Spaces and supported favorites/pins/nested folders/Today tabs map correctly; history is searchable; the second import adds no duplicate Spaces or sidebar tabs; original Arc files are unchanged

name: arc-live-passwords
description: Save actual Arc credentials through the real macOS Keychain and Chromium password store
given: Isolated browser profile using normal OS encryption and authorized Arc Safe Storage access
when: Import Arc passwords twice through the background bridge
then: First import adds encrypted login rows, matches the persisted SQLite count, and reports duplicates; second import adds zero rows; existing credentials stay intact; only counts/warnings reach the UI

name: arc-import-ui
description: Verify settings and setup import controls in the packaged browser
given: Fresh native browser profile and Arc installed
when: Open Settings Import and the initial setup import step in light and dark appearances
then: Arc mapping, password checkbox, cache/session limitations and retry actions are visible; browser list and footer remain usable

name: onboarding-replay-preserves-profile
description: Reopen onboarding from the visible Settings button with a populated profile
given: Installed UrAnus Browser with spaces, nested pins, favorites, Today tabs, saved passwords and custom preferences
when: Click Settings General Replay onboarding, traverse every step without taking an optional action, and finish; repeat and choose Skip tour
then: Space setup is read-only; all spaces/tabs/preferences and saved logins remain unchanged; restarting during replay resumes safely

name: macos-history-swipe
description: Check the browser's native swipe overlay and page transition.
given: A macOS build with the swipe navigation patch and two pages in the same tab's history.
when: Swipe back and forward past the threshold, then begin another swipe and release before the threshold.
then: Committed swipes move the old page aside in the swipe direction; a canceled swipe retracts the badge and leaves the current page in place.
